_comment: each agent role carries in its system prompt. One entry per role; a role
left out carries every capability its class declares, which is what an
ordinary campaign wants. The file exists to say something narrower.
TRACKED, unlike the machine-local config it replaces: it decides what a
wave's agents were told, so the commits that wave lands have to carry it
and an ablation reads as a diff. Being tracked also means `git worktree
add` checks it out into every agent worktree with no symlink.
Selection is descriptive, not an access boundary. Dropping a capability
removes its metadata and role guidance from the system prompt; the tool,
its binary and its checkout stay exactly as reachable from the agent's
shell. Where those live is derived from the environment crustify runs in
and is not configured here — see `crustify.deps`.
An empty list is a real answer (carry no optional skill at all) and is
_comment_orchestrator: * `wavefront` — plan waves and sub-campaigns with the semantic oracle.
* `audit`     — read the safety surface through `crustify audit`.
_comment_translator: * `wavefront` — query records the thin batch does not carry.
* `ffibox`    — represent C ownership with the wrap-primitive crate.
